Tremendous amounts of errors exist in the translations by other translators. To eliminate the problem Dar-us-Salam spent over 3 years in the publication of this book and presented a book which is translated into English in a very easy and simple language, so that all readers can understand it without difficulty. This is the unabridged version consisting of 7563 ahadith (about 4000 pages) which are presented neatly in smaller books format and printed on fine paper. Each book (subtopics in each volume categorized by very broad topics such as the Book of As-Salat) contains many chapters which represent one logical unit of Ahadith. Each book contains anywhere from one to 150 chapters with each chapter containing several Ahadith. This book will be a great addition to your library while giving you a true perspective on the traditions of the Prophet (PBUH). In Imam Bukhari's 'Al-Jami-al-Sahih' (Sahih Al Bukhari) the Imam had recorded all the Sayings of the Prophet which he found to be genuine after thorough examination and scrutiny. He spent sixteen years in research and examined more than sixty thousand Sayings from which he selected only sayings whose genuineness and accuracy he established beyond the slightest doubt. Deducting duplicates, the Imam's collection contain about four thousand distinct Sayings.

The Sealed Nectar was honoured by the World Muslim League as first prize winner book. Whoever wants to know the whole life style of the Prophet in detail must read this book. Muhammad (S) is the Messenger of Allah, and those who are with him, are severe against the disbelievers, and merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and falling down prostrate (in prayer), seeking bounty from Allah and (His) Good Pleasure. The mark of them (i.e. of their Faith) is on their faces (fore heads) from the traces of prostration (during prayers). This is their description in the Taurah (Torah). But their description in the Injeel (Gospel) is like a (sown) seed which sends forth its shoot, then makes it strong, and becomes thick and it stands straight on its stem, delighting the sowers, that He may enrage the disbelievers with them. Allah has promised those among them who believe and do righteous good deeds, forgiveness and a mighty reward (Paradise). (Al-Fath: 29) The Prophet Muhammad (S) said: "The example of guidance and knowledge with which Allah has sent me is like abundant rain falling on the earth. Some of which was fertile soil that absorbed rain-water and brought forth vegetation and grass in abundance. (And) another portion of it was hard and held the rain-water and Allah benefited the people with it and they utilized it for drinking (making their animals drink from it) and to irrigate the land for cultivation. (And) a portion of it was barren which could neither hold the water nor bring forth vegetation (then that land gave no benefits).

books.title: The Marriage of Shaykh al-Uthaymeen + 69 Q&A
books.subtitle: An epistle on marriage followed by 69 questions and answers
books.description: An epistle on marriage by Shaykh al-Uthaymeen, followed by 69 questions and answers on marriage rules and rulings.

books.title: Shaykh Muqbil's Responses to Women's Questions (Expanded Edition)
books.description: An expanded edition of the collection of questions women asked Shaykh Muqbil, covering topics such as purification, prayer, fasting, breastfeeding, marriage, divorce, mixing with men, and clothing.

books.title: The Qur'an: Juz Amma
books.subtitle: Arabic Text with English Meanings
books.description: Last Juz of the Qur'an, containing Surah an-Naba to Surah an-Nas. Includes blank lined pages for student notes, making it suitable for madrasa use.

books.title: Birth Prevention: An Islamic Perspective
books.description: A comprehensive Islamic view of birth prevention and related issues. Sets out the Islamic view of procreation, then surveys birth prevention methods, both traditional and modern, examining their rulings.

books.title: Our Precious Sprouts
books.subtitle: Islamic Regulations for Newborns
books.description: A book on raising children and Islamic regulations for newborns, covering naming, aqiqah, circumcision, and related topics according to the authentic Sunnah.

books.title: The Quest for Love & Mercy
books.subtitle: Marriage & Wedding in Islam
books.description: The first of a three-volume series on marriage based on the authentic Sunnah. Addresses gaps in existing English-language writing on the subject, especially for Muslims in English-speaking countries.

books.title: Closer Than a Garment
books.subtitle: Marital Intimacy According to the Pure Sunnah
books.description: Part 2 of a three-book series on marriage based on authentic Sunnah. Covers the etiquette of intimacy between spouses, prohibited acts, and addresses common questions on various aspects of intimacy.

books.title: Sincere Counsel to the Seekers of Sacred Knowledge
books.description: A book offering guidance for seekers of knowledge and parents on raising children, drawing from the wisdom of Ibn al-Jawzi.

books.title: Trials and Tribulations
books.subtitle: Wisdom and Benefits
books.description: Explores the tests believers face, their causes and purpose as a means of purification and divine mercy. Covers patience, humility, sincerity, and turning to supplication. Includes an appendix from the work of al-Izz ibn Abd as-Salam.

books.title: Etiquettes of Teachers and Students
books.description: A guide to the proper etiquettes and manners that should be observed by both teachers and students in the pursuit of Islamic knowledge.

books.title: At Their Feet: Piety Towards Parents
books.description: A work by Ibn al-Jawzi on the importance of honouring and being dutiful to one's parents, one of the greatest obligations in Islam after the worship of Allah.

books.title: Characteristics of the Hypocrites
books.description: A book on hypocrisy (nifaq) as a hidden spiritual illness. Covers the two types, major and minor, and how the Qur'an exposes hypocrites' beliefs and aims so believers can recognise and guard against them.

books.title: The Man Who Killed 99 Men
books.description: A retelling and explanation of the famous hadith about the man who killed ninety-nine men and sought repentance, drawing lessons on the vastness of Allah's mercy and the importance of sincere tawbah.

books.title: The Book of Marriage (Complete Set: Parts 1, 2 & 3)
books.subtitle: From the Explanation of Bulugh al-Maram
books.description: A comprehensive three-part set covering the Book of Marriage from the explanation of Bulugh al-Maram. Covers criteria for choosing a spouse, compatibility in marriage, rights and obligations, and related rulings.

books.title: The Book of Marriage (Part 3)
books.subtitle: From the Explanation of Bulugh al-Maram
books.description: Part 3 of the Book of Marriage series from the explanation of Bulugh al-Maram. Covers divorce, iddah, and related rulings.

books.title: The Book of Marriage (Part 2)
books.subtitle: From the Explanation of Bulugh al-Maram
books.description: Part 2 of the Book of Marriage series. Covers compatibility in marriage, differences in belief and religious commitment, and related scholarly discussions.

books.title: The Book of Marriage (Part 1)
books.subtitle: From the Explanation of Bulugh al-Maram
books.description: Part 1 of the Book of Marriage series. Explains hadiths from Bulugh al-Maram on the reasons people marry and the importance of choosing a spouse for piety.

books.title: The Legislated Divorce
books.description: Discusses divorce in Islam: when it is permitted, scholarly views on the best way to pronounce divorce, timing relative to the wife's menstrual cycle, and the waiting period (iddah).
